title: King − Man + Woman = ?
excerpt: The daily word puzzle where you do maths with meanings. Can you think like a word map? 10 rounds a day.
content_html:
How to play

A computer read billions of news articles and put every word on a map, with similar words close together.

You can do sums on that map: king − man + woman lands on queen.

10 rounds a day. Guess where the computer lands.
